plain_language: Every initial question and natural-language continuation is sent unchanged. No post-hoc translation into preferred species, artist or release filters. Explicit structured controls represent UI interactions already frozen in questions.json.
bindings: $bind placeholders in card_id are replaced only with the zero-based candidate_index from the previously recorded from_step result; bindings are never resolved by database search or reviewer discretion. Missing candidate blocks the remaining case and stays in the 30 denominator.
prefix_execution: Execute each full accumulated turn prefix through collector_journey.replay or /collector-journey. Record every raw response, exception and resolved action, not only final state. Expected-error cases stop after their final rejected action. Unexpected errors block remaining steps; do not silently retry changed inputs.
limits: Five candidates per response; at most 20 transcript actions. No live offers or marketplace requests. Runtime measurements and transport errors are reported without counting absent answers as useful.
scoring: Machine constraint checks and reviewer usefulness scores are separate. Full raw responses plus source/DB facet evidence are retained for independent scoring.
sample_status: Fresh agent-authored scenario set, architecture-aware, not real-user testing or a blinded randomized sample.
